title: Corrosion Possession
paragraphs: I used the portal to teleport over and reunited with Black Thunder, whom I’d left in someone’s care before heading to my Father’s place. The person I left him with is a hermit, you know. And there’s Fleon-chan, too.
“Kueee!”
Perhaps thanks to the upgrades I’d given him, Black Thunder had already taken on the form of a King.
“Like this!”
“Guaaaaaa!”
Fleon-chan is joining in, and they’re having a fun little pose-off. Oh? Fleon-chan is wearing something that looks like the mask I used to wear.
“Here comes Filolial Mask No. 2!”
“Guaaaaaa!”
They get along well, don’t they?
“Good morning there.”
“Ah, Number 1. We were just in the middle of discussing what this Jet-Black Lightning and the very essence of a hero are all about.”
Number 1, you say… I suppose this means even the Filolial Masks are becoming organized now. In other words, it seems Fleon-chan changes how she addresses me depending on the situation.
“Oh… It’s great to see you having so much fun.”
“We had a very fruitful discussion. It seems heroes have all sorts of beliefs and principles, doesn’t it?”
“Kue-kue!”
Black Thunder seems to be having a good time, too. He looks just as happy as Kuro-chan, whom we met in a previous loop.
“What a lively and energetic Filolial.”
It seems the Sage is also accepting Black Thunder with open arms. That’s just like the Sage. It seems he’s getting along well with Black Thunder, who’s famous for being a rowdy Filolial.
“Now then, Black Thunder. You haven’t fully awakened to your power yet. There’s still work to be done, but you understand, don’t you?”
Black Thunder nods vigorously at my words. He really loves this kind of vibe.
“Fleon-chan, this is the final touch to put our plan into action.”
“Yes! Well then, Immortal, I’m off!”
“But first, Black Thunder, use this machine to turn your Magical Power into thread… to weave darkness. That power will become the veil of darkness that envelops you!”
With that, I instruct Black Thunder to use the machine that converts Magical Power into thread so we can make the outfit in advance.
“Guaaaaaa!”

Black Thunder hooked his hand onto the machine that turns Magical Power into thread, just as I commanded, and began operating it. Eventually, he managed to convert a decent amount of Magical Power into thread. It shouldn’t be a problem to turn it into cloth first.
“Well then, let’s go hone our powers to the absolute limit!”
“Yes! Fleon will do her best!”
“Guaaaaaa!”

And so, we set out hunting once again. Class Up is necessary, but we can’t do it inside Melromarc right now because it would draw too much attention. We’ll focus on raising our base stats through aptitude training.
And so… by the evening of that day, we’d reached a point where we had a pretty good idea of where Fleon and Black Thunder stood in their training.
“Now then, Black Thunder. You’ve honed your power to the fullest. Show us your new form—your true form of darkness!”
“Guaaaaaa!”

With a flutter, Black Thunder spread his wings and gradually transformed into an angel. Yep. He’s no longer Kuro-chan—he’s taken on the form of a tall man. Since he was already on the verge of adulthood, Black Thunder’s transformation happened very quickly.
“Ha ha ha! Jet-Black Lightning! Manifest here!”
And so, Black Thunder proudly displayed his angelic form, looking quite pleased with himself. Whoa… He has a build similar to Ren’s, but the important parts are completely exposed.
“Now then… According to what I’ve heard, you’re the one who’s going to make our costumes, aren’t you? The Love Hunter <DRIVE>!”
Black Thunder has given me a nickname. It’s a good name, especially paired with “Drive Mode.” But perhaps I should respond with an even better one?
“The Love Hunter <DRIVE>? If I had to choose, I’d prefer ‘Eternal Hunter of Love Who Travels Through Time’!”
“That has a nice ring to it!”
Fleon-chan, in her Filolial form, answers excitedly as she flies by.
“The Love Hunter Who Travels Through Time… Ah—”
“That’s a bit long and hard to say. How about ‘The Love Hunter <TIME Drive>’?”
“Hmm… I suppose that’ll do. So, The Love Hunter <TIME Drive>. You’re going to make the Dark Cloak, right?”
“That’s right. As for the measurements… I think I’ve got a general idea. Is a design like this okay?”
I show Black Thunder—whom I met in the first world—the design he requested.
“Hehehe, having an excellent tailor <Doctor> like you saves me a lot of trouble… I can’t wait to meet the Dark Swordsman.”
“I agree. I’m also really looking forward to meeting this person named Itsuki. When should we go meet him?”
“Well… you can go visit him around noon tomorrow. Wouldn’t it be nice to just chat with Fleon and Itsuki as you please?”
“Yes!”
“Hahaha! I can’t wait!”
So, we decided to spend that evening making clothes for Fleon-chan and Black Thunder. Somehow, we managed to finish Fleon-chan and Black Thunder’s outfits in just one night.
“Thank you, Motoyasu-san.”
“You’re welcome. The Love Hunter <TIME Drive>.”
For Fleon-chan, I made a dress that was a bit different from Filo-tan’s—based on the outfit of Fleon-chan, the Fallen Angel of the Demon Realm. It suits her very well.
And as for Black Thunder… it’s a metallic-looking outfit. I used some leather-like material.
“Ugh… I’m so sleepy.”
Come to think of it, we’ve been working nonstop. I guess we should call it a night and get some rest. And so, that night, after finishing their costumes, I slept soundly.

The next day… my Father came to Melromarc Castle, and as expected, it seems he got into an argument with Trash. A little while after that, Ren, Itsuki, and the others—who had received thorough treatment with Magic and medicine at the clinic—emerged one by one, and the three Heroes had an audience with Trash.

“Heroes. You fought valiantly and repelled this latest wave. I hear the foe you faced suffered severe wounds from your attacks. While it’s sufficient that you were so close to victory, I want you to hone your skills thoroughly in preparation for future battles.”

With that, Trash handed us a grant, offering words of encouragement while taking care not to hurt our feelings as much as possible. He’s telling us to use this money as seed capital to grow even stronger. By the way, Trash has already had a falling-out with his Father, so there’s no doubt he’s in a bad mood. His tone sounded rather businesslike, after all.
“Bububuhi”

Crimson Swine, Lazy Pig, and the other pigs are starting to hassle me—I guess they’re wondering what’s up with me stumbling around lately. Ugh… I feel like I’m about to break out in hives. I’d better say something that sounds nice to their ears so I can get some rest. Otherwise, I won’t be able to move around freely.

“Everyone! We’ve got some time before the next wave. I just couldn’t fight properly last time because I hadn’t fully recovered from the previous battle. So today, everyone, just take a break however you like.”
“Oink-oink!”
“Oink!”

The Crimson Swines let out cries of joy. However, right after that, a Crimson Swine wrapped its arm around mine and tried to pull me along. Based on my experience, I suspect they’re suggesting we go on a date or something.
“Sorry. I’ve got something I need to take care of. I’ll make it up to you later, so just go rest!”
“O-oink, oink, oink—boo!”
Saying that, I slipped out from under the Crimson Swine’s grasp and left the area early. Knowing the Crimson Swine, I’m sure he’s thinking that if he just sucks up to me, everything will be fine.

As I thought this and looked outside through the hallway window, I saw Ren and Itsuki leaving the castle to prepare for their next battle. In the sky, two Fleon-chan, each carrying a Black Thunder, were keeping watch over the two of them. They’ll meet when the opportunity arises, I suppose.

So that settles the matter with Ren and Itsuki, then. My Father—who sacrificed himself to my Rival for my sake when I headed toward Siltvelt inside my mind—is tilting his head in confusion, but it’s all right! Now, as for what else there is to do… what’s there, I wonder?

Thinking about what comes next, I could just sit back and watch the commotion over my Father kidnapping my Finacée… but that would essentially mean getting close to Filo-tan. Ugh… I’m not mentally ready for that yet.

Freon-chan and Black Thunder have already gone to meet Itsuki and Ren. So, there’s only one thing left for me to do. Gathering various materials… and it might be the perfect time to go kill Takt in the most gruesome way possible! And with that, I headed for Faubrey.
I arrived at the town below Faubrey Castle via the portal.
“Well then…”
Perhaps I should go seek an audience with the Pig King first? It’s about the right time for him to be awake.

As I walked toward the castle with that in mind… one of the dragons from Takt’s entourage walked out of the castle gate as if it were the most natural thing in the world. Hmm… Teaming up with the Pig King inside the castle to flush out Takt and kill him in a gruesome manner is a bit of a cliché.

In that case, it wouldn’t be a bad idea to kill that dragon as an example, then, when Takt flies into a rage demanding to know where the culprit is, kill him in a gruesome manner as well. I have no intention of letting you die easily, Takt… I must make you witness as many varied and colorful ways of dying as there are Filolial-sama who were never even born.
With such thoughts in mind, I follow the dragon. Along the way, the dragon walked into a jewelry store.
“Ah, you’re… w-welcome… Lady Raildia, what kind of gemstones are you looking for today…”
The jeweler’s face is all tense. You can tell at a glance that she’s an unwelcome guest.
“This shop deals in jewels, doesn’t it? Show me.”
The dragon is browsing the jewelry in the shop with a rather high-handed attitude. As he looks around, he picks up several of the most expensive pieces.
“Not bad at all. I’ll take these.”
“Ah…”
“What? Do you have a problem with that?”

The dragon spreads its wings as if to intimidate him even further. It might be tempting to just kill him on the spot… Hmm. If I draw too much attention, I won’t be able to kill Takt in a truly gruesome manner.
“N-no… go ahead. I’ll let you have them.”

Incidentally, I heard later that dragons often use Takt’s authority and their status as powerful dragons to intimidate merchants dealing in precious metals, frequently taking their accessories through tactics bordering on extortion. It’s said that if you object, you’ll get beaten to a pulp, then have a crime you didn’t commit fabricated against you, and your property confiscated. They really are a bunch of lowlifes through and through.
“Very well, I’ll take it then. You’d better be grateful that your jewels have been added to my collection.”
What’s there to be grateful for? I’ll be the one to seize your property. Anyway, after making such threats, the dragon stopped by a jewelry store and took the gems for free.

Then… the dragon kept walking further and further down a deserted street. He’s probably heading toward a facility where the shadowy faction of the Takt faction within Faubrey is based. But this is my chance, too. I’ll close the distance in one go, pierce its vital spot, and finish it off with a Burst Lance.
And so… once I was completely out of sight, I used the Cloaking Lance to close in and just as I was about to raise my lance—
“Ugh… guh… w-what is it!? Ugh… uuugh! S-something is… taking over… uuuugh… AAAAAHHH!?”
Takt’s Dragon began clawing at its chest, crouching down while groaning.
“S-stop it! Guuu… I’m, I’m being overwritten… Aaaaaaah!? W-why… I can’t escape… Aaaaaaaah!? Takt… h-help me—”
Takt’s dragon writhed in agony for a moment before collapsing. It twitched and convulsed, then stopped moving. Eventually, it stood up smoothly.
“Nano! Hmm? What’s this… Ugh… I set this up thinking ‘maybe,’ but I never imagined it would actually turn out like this, Takt.”
Takt’s dragon muttered this after glancing around while repeatedly opening and closing its own hands.
“That’s right! Hey, Spear Hero, I know you’re hiding nearby. Come out.”

…Judging by that line and her reaction, could it be…? Either way, if she’s figured out I’m hiding, I have no choice but to come out. When I deactivated the Cloaking Lance and revealed myself, Takt’s dragon looked my way and narrowed his eyes.
“Spear Hero, you seem to have regained quite a bit of your strength. How are you feeling?”
“That line, that attitude… You—surely not…”
“You’re right. It’s Gaelion.”
Just as I thought!
“I’m sure the Spear Hero knows this, but Gaelion is set up so that if he gets close to a dragon, he can possess it… well, it’s not quite the same as possession, but it works that way.”
“And to think you’d choose to possess Takt’s Dragon—how ridiculous!”

HAHAHA, how pathetic. Takt’s dragon suits you perfectly. I haven’t forgotten the grudge I hold against you for taking my Father’s virginity. Since it’s Takt’s dragon, after all. Shall I just kill you right now?
Sword… 5%  Bow… 15%
